user_prompt:
Academic experimental setup diagram for a multi-agent social network research platform called CivicLens. Clean, minimal text, icon-heavy design for a conference presentation slide. White background, modern flat design style.

LAYOUT (left-to-right flow):

LEFT SIDE - EXPERIMENTAL VARIABLES as an adjustable control panel:
Four tunable parameters displayed vertically as stylized adjustment dials or slider controls, each with a distinctive icon:
1. AGENTS icon showing group of people silhouettes with N= and xN suggesting adjustable agent count
2. PERSONALITY icon showing theater masks or multiple distinct face icons with interchangeable symbols for different archetypes like curious, skeptic, leader, contrarian
3. SEED POSTS icon showing document or newspaper stack icons with adjustable quantity indicator
4. DURATION icon showing clock or hourglass with adjustable time indicator t=

CENTER - THE PLATFORM as a large prominent element:
A large stylized social network platform labeled Moltbook depicted as a rectangular forum or feed interface with post cards, upvote arrows, and comment threads visible inside. This is the central hub where all agents interact. Style it like a simplified Reddit or forum UI mockup with visible post entries.

RIGHT SIDE - DOCKER CONTAINERS WITH AGENTS:
A grid or cluster of 8 to 10 Docker container icons as rectangular boxes. Each container has a small robot or bot icon inside representing an AI agent. The containers are color-coded to show different personality types. Some containers share the same color showing same personality, others have different colors showing personality diversity. Greek letter labels on each container: alpha, beta, gamma, delta, epsilon, zeta, eta, theta. Three dots or plus-N notation to suggest the number is variable and expandable.

CONNECTIONS:
- Bidirectional arrows between Docker agent containers and the Moltbook platform showing agents reading and posting
- Arrows from the Seed Posts variable on the left pointing INTO the Moltbook platform showing injection of seed content
- Dashed lines connecting each variable control dial to its corresponding element in the setup

STYLE:
- Clean white background, flat design icons, absolutely no 3D effects or shadows
- Color palette: soft blue for platform, orange or amber for variable controls, teal or green for agent Docker containers, purple accents for personality variation
- Minimal text using mostly icons, Greek letters, and mathematical notation
- Publication quality suitable for an academic conference slide
- No gradients, clean vector-style look

iterations.prompt:
Create a high-quality scientific diagram with these requirements:

VISUAL QUALITY:
- Clean white or light background (no textures or gradients)
- High contrast for readability and printing
- Professional, publication-ready appearance
- Sharp, clear lines and text
- Adequate spacing between elements to prevent crowding

TYPOGRAPHY:
- Clear, readable sans-serif fonts (Arial, Helvetica style)
- Minimum 10pt font size for all labels
- Consistent font sizes throughout
- All text horizontal or clearly readable
- No overlapping text

SCIENTIFIC STANDARDS:
- Accurate representation of concepts
- Clear labels for all components
- Include scale bars, legends, or axes where appropriate
- Use standard scientific notation and symbols
- Include units where applicable

ACCESSIBILITY:
- Colorblind-friendly color palette (use Okabe-Ito colors if using color)
- High contrast between elements
- Redundant encoding (shapes + colors, not just colors)
- Works well in grayscale

LAYOUT:
- Logical flow (left-to-right or top-to-bottom)
- Clear visual hierarchy
- Balanced composition
- Appropriate use of whitespace
- No clutter or unnecessary decorative elements
